invariants.rule: Material intent must not remain conversation-only; persist it with provenance.
Solution is distinct from Analysis, Decision, Requirement, Task, Verification and Acceptance.
A proposed Solution is not selected without an attributable Decision.
BusinessRule is a durable domain rule and must remain distinct from Decision rationale and Requirement history.
TechnicalContract should reference the authoritative definition/revision/digest instead of creating an unnecessary second authoritative copy.
Code review, implementation and runtime findings remain Finding records with profiles/categories; do not create duplicate parallel finding entities.
Known scope uses stable scope identities; unknown scope is not guessed.
Derived current-state views and runtime/deployment observations must carry freshness/validity metadata.
Derived views are rebuildable projections, not independent competing truth stores.
Deployment/runtime state is an observation at a time from a source; stale observations must not be presented as live state.
Retrieval/context packages preserve traceability and must not become a parallel knowledge store.
Retrieval must distinguish proposed, active, superseded, conflicted and unknown states and report source mismatch/incomplete context.
Every new Task has P0/P1/P2/P3/unassigned; never guess.
Priority is not authorization and is distinct from execution_order.
A stale writer must merge/reconcile rather than overwrite newer canonical state.
Migration/compaction preserves material derivation, stable IDs, provenance and rationale.
Secrets, passwords, tokens and private keys must not be stored in PE.
